---
applyTo: "docs/**, CHANGELOG.md, **/*.md"
description: "Docs, ADRs, CHANGELOGs and the canonical design tracker (md → csv regenerated in the same commit)"
---

# Docs & tracker

## Canonical files
- `docs/mixai-design-tracker.md` — the ONE plan/tracker (WP0…WP14, decisions D1…D24, research, architecture).
  `docs/mixai-design-tracker.csv` is DERIVED: after any `.md` edit run `node scripts/tracker-regen-csv.mjs`
  and commit both files together. Never hand-edit the CSV rows for WP items.
- Row shape: `| WPx-yy | <item> | <status> |` (or with type/surface/notes columns). Status vocabulary:
  `todo` · `doing` · `done <sha>` · `blocked <why>` · `dropped <why>`. Reference IDs in commits
  (`feat(ui): WP2-05 …`).
- `docs/design-system.md` — spec for tokens/theme/`@mmo/ui`. `docs/adr/NNNN-*.md` — one ADR per architectural
  decision (0002 headless core, 0004 API, 0005 Subsonic, 0006 codai, 0008 design system; 0009 pirate-embed
  removal and 0010 Media Home are planned in WP14). Format: Status/Context/Decision/Consequences/Alternatives.
- `docs/arhitectura/build-performance.md` — measured build times; re-measure with `scripts/measure-builds.ps1`
  after tooling changes, never estimate.
- `docs/arhitectura/gates.md` — planned in WP13-06 (mutation-tested gate matrix).
- `apps/web/AGENTS.md` — generated by `next dev` (`nextjs-agent-rules` block). Keep it; committing the
  re-added block with your work keeps the tree clean.
- CHANGELOGs: root `CHANGELOG.md` (web/extension/tv/mixai), `server/CHANGELOG.md`. Keep a Changelog style,
  newest first; entry per user-visible change together with the version bump.

## Writing rules
- EN prose, terse and imperative; RO business/product terms are fine (`Setări`, `factură`). Existing RO docs
  under `docs/{aplicatie,arhitectura,…}` stay RO — match the file's language.
- LF line endings, no BOM. Relative links (`../AGENTS.md`), never absolute file paths.
- Every command you document must exist: `rg` the `package.json` scripts / the script file first.
- Facts only — no "should work". Numbers get a date and the command that produced them.
- Never paste secrets, tokens or full `.env` content; reference the variable name.
- Legacy docs (`docs/concept/ui-ux.md`, `docs/legacy-*.md`, `NAVIGARE.md`) describe pre-2026-09 UI; when
  you touch them, add a pointer to `docs/design-system.md` rather than silently rewriting history.
- `docs/companion/*` pages that never existed are linked as anchors into `server/README.md` — do not
  recreate them.

## Gotchas
- `tracker-regen-csv.mjs` keeps non-WP rows from the old CSV and only rewrites `WPx-yy` rows; a malformed
  MD row (missing trailing `|`) is silently skipped — check the CSV diff.
- Two agents bump CHANGELOG concurrently: re-read the file immediately before editing; use targeted edits.
- Planned link checker: `docs-ci.yml` with lychee (WP13-05) — write links that will pass it.

## Verify
- `node scripts/tracker-regen-csv.mjs; git --no-pager diff --stat -- docs/mixai-design-tracker.csv` shows only
  the rows you changed.
- `rg -n "WP\d+-\d\d" docs/mixai-design-tracker.md | rg <your-id>` shows the status you set.
- Markdown renders: no unclosed tables (each row same column count), fenced blocks closed.
